educationalGoal: Real various problems in engineering, science and social science are often described by differential equations. Students will learn how to solve 1st order ordinary differential equations (ODEs), 2nd order constant-coefficient linear ODEs and systems of simultaneous linear ODEs, and will understand (1) how to construct mathematical models of phenomena, (2) concrete solution method and (3) how to analyze solution properties and characteristics. The students will join computing project using MATLAB, and will gain experience to apply ODEs to real various problems.
advice: In the class, the students will learn differential equations (ODEs): (1) 1st order ODEs, (2) 2nd order constant-coefficient linear ODEs, and (3) systems of 1st order simultaneous linear ODEs. The students will learn the analytical methods: (I) how to express physical and social phenomena with ODEs (construction of mathematical models), (II) how to solve specific types of ODEs, (III) analytical methods in which students will analyze obtained solutions and acquire information pertinent to the activities of engineers such as the pattern and the speed of changes in various phenomena. After the student learn the main themes of ODEs, the students will apply the above knowledge (I), (II), and (III) to computing projects by using formula manipulation system, and submit a report of their results. In the class, the students will use MATLAB in the following activities: 1) visualizations of the solutions for ODEs, 2) analysis of the effect of parameters of ODEs on changes of the solutions, 3) analysis of the derivation of the solution involving many calculations or search of optimal solution and the reason. Therefore, the students should install MATLAB on individual notebook computer, and should master basic usage of MATLAB beforehand.
books: Textbooks:Advanced Engineering Mathematics 1: Ordinary Differential Equation (8th Edition) [Baifukan] Reference books:None Reserved books:Advanced Engineering Mathematics, 10th Edition [Wiley]
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of differential and integral calculations, differential equations, and linear algebra in the subjects: Fundamental Mathematics for Information Science, Advanced Mathematics for Information Science A, Linear Algebra I, and Linear Algebra II. Basic computer skills of MATLAB in computing projects.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand geometric concept of 1st order ODE and predict behavior of solution using direction field.
Be able to construct a 2nd order homogeneous linear ODE for various phenomena of interest and obtain solution.
Be able to construct a system of 1st order simultaneous ODEs for various phenomena and obtain the solution.
Be able to analyze solutions obtained from ODEs and evaluate the pattern and speed of changes in phenomena.
Be able to understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics.
Be able to demonstrate an understanding of all topics, attend every class, and do the required work.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the concept of ODEs and accurately explain the geometric properties of the solutions. (2) Construct accurate mathematical models with ODEs from scientific and social phenomena. (3) Accurately analyze the structure of ODEs and select an appropriate solution method. (4) Draw the graph of the solution of an ODEs and clearly explain the behavior of the solution. (5) Accurately analyze the behavior of solutions, predict future states of a phenomenon, obtain optimal solutions, and explain the reason for the predictions. (6) Understand and successfully complete all homework.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the concept of ODEs and explain the geometric properties of the solutions. (2) Construct mathematical models with ODEs from scientific and social phenomena. (3) Analyze the structure of ODEs and select an appropriate solution method. (4) Draw the graph of the solution of an ODE and explain the behavior of the solution. (5) Analyze the behavior of solutions, predict future states of a phenomenon, and obtain optimal solutions. (6) Understand and complete all homework.
